name: chapter-bar
summary: A chapter progress bar along the top: a cell a chapter, as wide as its title; the current one fills with a dot at its front and keeps its title; every title shows for a few seconds as each chapter starts.
use: lay = layout(params, measure) once; st = state(params, t, lay); canvas(ctx, st, params), or els = build(root, params, lay) once and dom(els, st). boxes(params, st, measure) gives window.film.ui(t)'s boxes.

slots.name: chapters
slots.text: [{ t, title, b? }]: each chapter's start (s), its title and its end (default: the next chapter's start)

slots.name: span
slots.text: [a, b]: when the bar shows (default: the first chapter's start to the last one's end); up on frame 0 when it starts at 0

slots.name: end
slots.text: the film's length, the last chapter's end when it names none

slots.name: y
slots.text: the track's top; the titles sit 58 px under it (keep both in the action-safe box)

slots.name: size
slots.text: the titles' size; 46 px is the floor for Chinese at 1080p

slots.name: pad
slots.text: a cell's width beyond its title's

slots.name: margin
slots.text: the bar's distance from the frame's sides; titles that do not fit side by side get even cells and only the current one shows

slots.name: all
slots.text: how long every title shows from each chapter's start

slots.name: fadeIn
slots.text: the bar's fade in (when it starts after 0)

slots.name: fadeOut
slots.text: the bar's fade out at the end of its span

slots.name: colors
slots.text: track (drawn at 28 %), past chapters' fill, the current fill and the dot, the titles, and the dark of the band and the outline as r,g,b

slots.name: band
slots.text: a dark band from the top edge behind the bar, so it reads over any picture

slots.name: font
slots.text: the titles' CSS family list (lib/text.js fontStack(tokens, role) makes one from a style's tokens)

slots.name: weight
slots.text: the titles' weight (PingFang SC has nothing above 600: engines/README.md)

provenance.note: the canvas-film engine's chapter bar, made a component with a DOM painter
